verdict.rationale: Keycloak is an IAM/OAuth server, so a token-exchange or token-vault capability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents token exchange, retrieval of stored third-party tokens, or agent-delegated consent flows. Identity brokering and account linking are adjacent features, and client credentials explicitly grant access on behalf of the client rather than the user, so none of these count as delivering the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent obtain short-lived, user-consented tokens for third-party APIs (token vault/exchange) so tool calls run under the user's delegated authority
